column3: Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, through the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God, which is your reasonable service.
And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may test and approve what the will of God is—the good and pleasing and perfect.
For through the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think more highly than one ought to think, but to think toward sound judgment, as God apportioned to each a measure of faith.
For just as in one body we have many members, but all the members do not have the same function,
so we who are many are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.
And having different gracious gifts according to the grace given to us: if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;
if service, in the service; or the one teaching, in the teaching;
or the one encouraging, in the encouragement; the one sharing, with generosity; the one leading, with diligence; the one showing mercy, with cheerfulness.
Let love be without hypocrisy, abhorring evil, clinging to good;
in brotherly love, devoted to one another, in honor giving preference to one another,
not lazy in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
rejoicing in hope, enduring in affliction, persisting in prayer,
sharing in the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.
Bless those who persecute; bless and do not curse.
Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
Think the same toward one another, not thinking lofty things but associating with the lowly. Do not become wise in yourselves.
Repay no one evil for evil; take thought for what is good before all people.
If possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with all people.
Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to wrath, for it is written, “Vengeance is mine; I will repay,” says the Lord.
But “if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink; for by doing this you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
Do not be conquered by evil, but conquer evil with good.
